directions: In this task, you are to write an essay on the role of physical exercise in achieving success at college. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Physical exercise plays a crucial role in achieving success at college. To begin with, it helps students maintain good health. College life is often filled with heavy academic loads and stress. Regular physical exercise, such as jogging or playing basketball, can strengthen the immune system, reducing the chances of getting sick. For example, a student who exercises regularly is less likely to miss classes due to illness, thus ensuring continuous learning.

In addition, physical exercise can improve mental health. It releases endorphins, which are known as "happy hormones". These hormones can relieve stress and anxiety, making students more focused and efficient in their studies. A student feeling overwhelmed by assignments may find that a short workout can clear their mind and boost their productivity.

Furthermore, participating in sports activities can enhance social skills. Joining a sports team or club allows students to interact with their peers, develop teamwork spirit, and build friendships. These social connections can provide support and opportunities, which are essential for success in college.

In conclusion, physical exercise is not only beneficial for physical health but also for mental well-being and social development. College students should make physical exercise a part of their daily routine to achieve success in their college years.
